_: Thresholds of the probe's rules (PLANO-SONDA.md §4): each with why. Starting values, to be tuned against the first reports.

longFrameMs.why: one display refresh at 60 Hz: a task longer than it drops a frame

longGcMs.why: half a frame: a GC pause this long is seen as a hitch when the frame was already half spent

largeMessageBytes.why: 1 MB structured-cloned per message copies at roughly 1 GB/s: a millisecond of main thread each

cpuSamplingUs.why: plan §3 [B]: 100 µs resolves functions of a tenth of a frame; the clean pass carries the profiler alone

allocSamplingBytes.why: V8's default sampling interval: every allocation site over 16 KB in the scene is seen

settleStableMs.why: the scene is settled when its signature (triangles, levels, vehicles, people) held for 3 s and nothing waits to land

settleMaxMs.why: an opening or an edit that has not settled in 90 s is itself a finding

holdMs.why: plan §5: 5 s parked per still scene

snapshotMaxMb.why: a heap snapshot is written as JSON of about the heap's size; over this the write takes minutes and the analysis needs more memory than the machine spares
